To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the AAI space is very complex and diverse, that there is no best solution that fits all requirements and environments, and that there are a number of technologies that can be combined in various ways to provide a comprehensive AAI.
there is no one-size-fits-all AAI, and that the choice of the right AAI depends on various factors such as the application domain, the type of users, and the type of data that is being protected.

(i) there are several approaches that can be used for building an AAI, (ii) every approach has its own advantages and disadvantages, (iii) there is no single approach for building a comprehensive AAI, and (iv) the choice for a specific AAI depends on the requirements of the specific application.

the design and development of an AAI that combines the strengths of various technologies and approaches.
